about_the_game:
Car Guys Demo

Experience the chaotic fun of Car Guys in this special demo edition!

⚠️ Please note: This demo showcases a single track and lets you race against AI-controlled opponents only. The full game will include real-time multiplayer, more tracks, and much more content.

Features in this Demo:

🏁 One Track, Pure Action

• Jump straight into the race on a specially selected circuit.

• Fast-paced gameplay that shows the core fun of Car Guys.

🤖 Race Against Bots

• Compete with AI opponents tuned to give you a challenge.

• Perfect way to practice your driving and missile skills.

🚗 Power-Ups & Combat Racing

• Pick up items like missiles to blast rivals out of the way.

• Learn the basics of offensive and defensive driving.

🎨 Vibrant Visuals

• Casual yet colorful style designed for quick, accessible fun.

What’s Waiting in the Full Game:

🔥 Real-Time Multiplayer with players worldwide.

🌍 National Leaderboards to represent your country.

🚀 More Circuits, Cars, and Modes, including Party Mode with up to 10 friends.

🏆 Progression & Customization with unlockable vehicles and skins.

👉 Try the demo now, and if you enjoy it, don’t forget to add Car Guys to your wishlist to get the full multiplayer experience at launch!
